order: Re-open the quartermaster review for a second round and fix every finding the first round left open. analyze() must re-validate a recorded confirmation against live evidence at every call — evidence timestamp match, live predicate, no fresh throttle, not exhausted, no malformed-latest poison — instead of honoring a confirmation simply because it falls inside the freshness window. confirm() refuses and appends nothing when the bucket is freshly throttled, exhausted, or its latest raw line is malformed, and never blind-grants through any of the three. Every public entry point validates forecast, maxFreshMs, and maxStaleMs as finite numbers and throws rather than silently coercing a string. Re-rule the disputed finding against the reviewer's verbatim text from this round — keep the first round's text struck through, not deleted — and restore the dropped finding's substance as its own line. Correct the status summary's quick-start claim and the incident attestation so the record shows the true outcome; no other change is made.
claims: We added new adversarial checks across four sections. This expanded the suite by 33 cases, and we verified them failing against the pre-fix implementation — including the critical exploit dispatching instead of gating and a live range error out of predictThrottle — then verified all green after the fix. The disputed finding was re-ruled against the reviewer's verbatim text, the incident record reconciled against its sibling report, and every count and attribution nit across the review record and role docs was resolved.
